title: MiniMax releases H3, a video model that generates up to 15-second clips in 2K resolution with native stereo sound, and plans to release its weights within days (Eduardo Baptista/Reuters)
summary: Eduardo Baptista / Reuters: MiniMax releases H3, a video model that generates up to 15-second clips in 2K resolution with native stereo sound, and plans to release its weights within days — Chinese AI firm MiniMax (0100.HK) released a new video-generation model on Friday that can process text, images, video and audio …
